title: Post-merge reconciliation: b7z9.3.1 unit test must pin structural-stage reject once worker-6's vector landing merges
description: Found while executing b7z9.3.3 (worker-6 landed the equivalent recipe on their local beads-worker-6 branch as b926255ab2 'test(vectors): R-05-035 nonzero Target Flags reject vector', unpushed; bead closed by worker-6). Once b926255ab2 merges, lichen-rpl message.rs is_generalized_target_body rejects nonzero Target flags at the ENVELOPE (structural) stage, which breaks the committed b7z9.3.1 test nonzero_target_flags_dao_rejected_before_state_mutation (rust/lichen-node/src/routing/tests.rs): it unwraps SignatureVerifiedDao::verify_signature (now Err before crypto) and asserts RouteRejected at extraction. Fix (validated green on my tree against the envelope guard): assert matches!(SignatureVerifiedDao::verify_signature(&wire, origin, RPL_INSTANCE_ID, root_addr, Some(identity.pubkey)), Err(DaoVerifyError::Malformed(_))) with comment 'nonzero Target flags must reject the DAO at the structural stage'; DELETE the subsequent process_signature_verified_dao_at_ms RouteRejected assert (the verified envelope no longer exists); KEEP the no-mutation tail (same-origin-sequence flags=0 DAO still Ok(Applied)) and update the test comment (extraction check = defense in depth for raw-DAO paths). The extract_updates check in lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs stays (defense in depth; C parity at rpl_dao_process.c). Priority P2 because the merge WILL break lichen-node lib tests otherwise. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.3.3.
close_reason: Force-close with verification: the prescribed reconciliation is LANDED ON MAIN via 2e7991f1ec 'test(routing): pin structural-stage reject for nonzero Target flags' (in main per merge-base check). The test at main's routing/tests.rs asserts Err(DaoVerifyError::Malformed(_)) from verify_signature (structural-stage pin) plus a raw-ingest dao_parents_for_source rejection (defense-in-depth), and the no-mutation tail is retained. Re-verified today: cargo test nonzero_target_flags -> 1 passed / 0 failed. Bead condition satisfied; nothing further to reconcile. (Corrects my earlier close reason that located the test in rpl_stack/tests.rs — it lives in routing/tests.rs.)
